### Summary of Changes

1. **Database & Official Feedback Account (T-01)**
   - Added idempotent D1 migration [0007_mentions_and_official_account.sql](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/migrations/0007_mentions_and_official_account.sql) defining `official_accounts` and `post_mentions`, and seeding the `official_feedback` (`官方反馈`) account.
   - Added [official.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/lib/official.ts) (`ensureOfficialFeedbackAccount`, `isOfficialAccountEmail`, `isOfficialUserId`, `isReservedOfficialNickname`) and enforced permission isolation in [auth.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/auth.ts) so the official account cannot log in via OTP or be modified/impersonated by normal users.

2. **Backend `@` Mention Parsing, Search & Persistence (T-02)**
   - Added [mentions.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/lib/mentions.ts) (`extractMentionTokens`, `resolveMentionedUsers`, `fetchMentionsForPostIds`) to parse `@username` mentions safely while ignoring email addresses (e.g., `user@example.com`), URLs, and unknown `@` handles without failing post creation.
   - Added `GET /api/users/mention-candidates` and official flags in [users.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/users.ts), pinning the official feedback account at the top of mention results.
   - Updated [posts.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/posts.ts), [admin.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/admin.ts), [discover.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/discover.ts), and [types.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/types.ts) to persist and return resolved `mentions` and `isOfficial` / `officialBadge` metadata.

3. **Frontend `@` Autocomplete & Highlight Rendering (T-03)**

   - Updated [PostComposer.tsx](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/client/src/components/PostComposer.tsx) with an `@` mention popover (official account pinned first, keyboard navigation with `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Enter`/`Tab`/`Escape`, click insertion, and synchronous `useLayoutEffect` caret restoration).
